subject: science
concept: Understanding animal life cycles and that different animals develop differently (e.g. metamorphosis vs. direct growth)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sequences real or virtual life-cycle stage cards for a metamorphosis example (e.g. butterfly) and a direct-growth example (e.g. dog)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an animal to its correct life cycle diagram
exercise.abstract: Student explains the difference between the two life cycle types using an example of each

misconception_flags: assumes all animals go through metamorphosis

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
